scope: Composition only. Direct problem input; independent of recognition scores and its release gate.

schema_binding.node_types: Use the bound codec pure operators, effectful calls, statements, literals/references and hygienically expanded recipes. No arbitrary Python holes or hidden complete-answer replacement.
schema_binding.edges: Root owns body sequence and return expression. Preorder first-child/next-sibling tree; trailing EMPTY slots only; no cycles, shared children or unreachable active nodes. Bindings address inputs or preceding declarations and obey lexical scope, mutability, port types and resource effects.
schema_binding.limits: Keep codec resource/graph/execution limits. Freeze the selected prediction descriptor, type vocabulary and slot limits in the candidate manifest; the historical 192-slot descriptor is a baseline, not a general goal limit.

forbidden_input: recognized production-index identity or stored answer prerequisite
output: corrected graph and hash or null
interface.answer: Return assembled source only for a valid graph that passes public checks within the complete request budget. Independent correctness is scored afterward, not asserted by the route.
interface.invalid_graph: Retain raw prediction, reject before execution, and abstain. Corrected route may attempt only its sealed bounded correction; unresolved violations, budget exhaustion and execution failures abstain.
interface.infrastructure_failure: Record separately, never count as correctness or silent task exclusion; no automatic graph substitution.

routes.raw: One parallel model prediction; unchanged strict decoder; no correction, repair search or source generation.
routes.constrained: Use the same checkpoint, input and captured raw prediction. A bounded deterministic correction may repair malformed structure/bindings under the sealed authority; record every edit. A fresh model prediction is not this paired route.
routes.nearest_training_graph: Simple existing-system baseline: nearest frozen fit-side graph by the same provisioned embedding, deterministic tie-break by graph hash, interface/type-compatible candidates only, positional alpha-renaming only, no literal/control-flow/algorithm edits; no compatible graph means abstention.
routes.historical_reservation: typed_confirmation_v1.json is immutable. Its unguided_search and retrieval_guided_search obligations remain for that reserved campaign. Adding the corrected route requires an explicit sealed addendum; this document does not silently drop a route or open the reservation.

correction_authority.allowed: Only declared graph-schema/type/scope/effect constraints applied to captured model proposals. Select and freeze edit kinds, ordering, tie-breaks, maximum edits/candidates and stopping rule on development cases.
correction_authority.preserve: An already valid raw graph stays unchanged in this correction experiment. A valid but wrong algorithm is not a malformed graph.
forbidden: replacing the graph with a hand-authored or retrieved complete solution
consulting expected public or private outputs to choose edits
changing problem requirements, codec vocabulary or execution limits
correction_authority.public_tests: May reject the final graph, not drive this correction. Test-guided repair/search is a separate route and cost.

paired_measurement.tasks: Identical composition cases and initial inputs for every route; never reuse the 20 recognition questions as the composition comparison.
paired_measurement.checkpoint: Same frozen checkpoint, raw prediction and inference inputs for raw versus corrected; preserve logits if the mechanism uses them.

corrections.useful: Raw does not produce an accepted correct answer; corrected does.
corrections.harmful: Raw produces an accepted correct answer and corrected does not, or corrected introduces a wrong acceptance.
corrections.neutral: Neither useful nor harmful; report validity-only repairs and unchanged results separately.
corrections.evidence: Compute these categories after both responses are fixed, using the same independent tests. Missing scoring evidence remains unknown, never correct.

paired_measurement.complete: Count all route work and correction cost, including failures and abstentions. Shared prediction time is charged to both raw and corrected totals. Use actual elapsed intervals without double-counting nested stages.
paired_measurement.budget: Retain the existing 2-second warm request envelope including public checking. Freeze any development-motivated revision explicitly before scoring; faster abstention is not a solving win.

opening_gate: Implement raw, constrained and baseline routes; verify legal/illegal graph behavior and actual execution on development cases.
Select correction only on development composition cases. Define numerical development acceptance before selecting a candidate; record failures and harmful corrections.
Seal code/configuration, checkpoint, encoding, codec, components, training/development inputs, evaluator, protected cohort, budgets, deterministic tie-breaks and environment.
Reconcile and seal all baselines required by the existing reserved campaign without altering its 66-problem denominator.
Run one protected scoring pass after the seal; no tuning, task replacement or unseen claim after feedback. Interruptions resume the same frozen run.
nearby_variants_2b: Separate freshly authored semantic-variant evaluation with its own seal; a familiar base may be allowed, but changed requirements and answers remain unseen. Do not use variants to tune the frozen 2a composer after evaluation starts. Preserve the broader 66-problem reservation separately.
autonomous_development_loop: Do not launch until raw composition, constrained composition and protected scoring have independently established receipts. Any later development loop uses permitted development feedback only and creates a new version; protected outcomes are not training rewards.
